signal: AudioEye reported record Q1 2026 results, 127,000 customers, and launched its next-gen accessibility platform plus the 2026 Accessibility Advantage Report

email.body1:
Becca, saw AudioEye posted record Q1, crossed 127,000 customers, and shipped the next-gen platform.

With demand rising and the 2026 report showing 59 percent of orgs at compliance risk, your SDR team's follow-up volume and response speed decide how much of that interest converts. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so your reps cover far more without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to AudioEye's top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Becca, quick follow-up for AudioEye.

When inbound interest spikes like this, ramp time and first-touch speed are where pipeline is won or lost. The teams that keep up automate the research and first drafts so reps spend their hours in live conversations, not admin.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Becca, last bit of proof for AudioEye.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your SDR team's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Becca, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up without adding SDRs is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most coming off a record quarter, and I know that pace is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I will tailor it to AudioEye either way.
